Specification: This module is a small test specification for the Sequences operator SelectSeq. It defines a fixed integer sequence and several predicate operators, then asserts invariants characterizing how SelectSeq filters the sequence under predicates that always pass, always fail, select even elements, or select elements greater than 1. The module also includes a minimal state with one variable and simple Init and Next definitions, but it does not define a temporal Spec or any fairness or proof structure.
